name: io.github.couchbase/mcp-server-couchbase
description: Couchbase MCP servers: Operational and Operational Insights clusters.

environmentVariables.name: CB_CONNECTION_STRING
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase connection string. Required for connecting to the cluster.

environmentVariables.name: CB_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase database username. Required for basic authentication.

environmentVariables.name: CB_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase database password. Required for basic authentication.

environmentVariables.name: CB_CA_CERT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase CA certificate path. Required for TLS authentication in non Capella clusters.

environmentVariables.name: CB_CLIENT_CERT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase client certificate path. Required for mTLS authentication.

environmentVariables.name: CB_CLIENT_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase client key path. Required for mTLS authentication.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_READ_ONLY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase read only mode. Set to true to disable write operations: KV document, scope/collection and index write tools are not loaded, and SQL++ queries that modify data are blocked. Set to false to allow them. Default is true.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server (stdio, http or sse). Default is stdio. OAuth is only honored with http.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host to run the MCP server on (default: 127.0.0.1). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port to run the MCP server on (default: 8000). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Tools to disable. Accepts comma-separated tool names (e.g., 'tool_1,tool_2') or a file path containing one tool name per line.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names that require user confirmation before execution. Also accepts a file path containing one tool name per line. Requires the MCP client to support elicitation.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Logging level for the MCP server. One of off, debug, info, warning, error. Use 'off' to disable logging entirely. Invalid values fall back to info. Default is info.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_SINKS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of log destinations. Allowed values: stderr, file. Include 'file' to write per-level log files; include 'stderr' to write to the console. Default is stderr.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Base path for the per-level log files. One rotating file is written per level (e.g. mcp_server.info.log, mcp_server.error.log). Only used when 'file' is in CB_MCP_LOG_SINKS. Default is mcp_server.log.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
environmentVariables.description: Global maximum size in MB per-level log file before it rotates, inherited by every level unless overridden by a per-level CB_MCP_LOG_<LEVEL>_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB. A value of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default (1 MB) with a startup warning. Default is 1 (1 MB).

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: [DEPRECATED] Global rotation size in bytes; use CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB (MB) instead. Still honored for backward compatibility but ignored when CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB is also set. A value of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default with a startup warning.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ERROR_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
environmentVariables.description: Rotation size in MB for the ERROR log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for ERROR; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_WARNING_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
environmentVariables.description: Rotation size in MB for the WARNING log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for WARNING; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_INFO_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
environmentVariables.description: Rotation size in MB for the INFO log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for INFO; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_DEBUG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
environmentVariables.description: Rotation size in MB for the DEBUG log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for DEBUG; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
environmentVariables.description: Number of rotated backup files kept per-level log file, excluding the live file. Applies to every level unless overridden per level. Set to 0 to keep only the live file (still capped by the rotation size). Default is 1.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ERROR_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
environmentVariables.description: Rotated backups kept for the ERROR log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for ERROR; inherits it when unset.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_WARNING_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
environmentVariables.description: Rotated backups kept for the WARNING log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for WARNING; inherits it when unset.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_INFO_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
environmentVariables.description: Rotated backups kept for the INFO log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for INFO; inherits it when unset.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_DEBUG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
environmentVariables.description: Rotated backups kept for the DEBUG log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for DEBUG; inherits it when unset.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_JWKS_URI
environmentVariables.description: JWKS endpoint of the identity provider used to verify bearer JWT signatures. Required to enable OAuth, along with CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ISSUER and CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE. Only honored when CB_MCP_TRANSPORT=http.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ISSUER
environmentVariables.description: Expected JWT 'iss' claim value. Also advertised as the authorization server in Protected Resource Metadata when CB_MCP_OAUTH_MCP_BASE_URL is set. Required to enable OAuth.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE
environmentVariables.description: Expected JWT 'aud' claim value. Required to enable OAuth.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ALGORITHM
environmentVariables.description: JWT signing algorithm. One of RS256/384/512, ES256/384/512, PS256/384/512. Default is RS256.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_MCP_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public base URL of this MCP server. When set, the server publishes RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata at <base_url>/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp so PRM-aware clients can discover the authorization server. Optional.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_READ_LABEL
environmentVariables.description: Override the OAuth scope label the server treats as 'read' access; advertised in PRM and matched against the token's scope/scp claim. Use when your IdP cannot emit the canonical form. Default is couchbase-mcp:read.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_WRITE_LABEL
environmentVariables.description: Override the OAuth scope label the server treats as 'write' access; same semantics as CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_READ_LABEL. Default is couchbase-mcp:write.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Embedding provider for run_vector_search / run_search_vector_search: one of couchbase, openai, cohere, voyage, bedrock. Unset disables both tools' embedding step until configured.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model name/ID for the configured embedding provider.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the configured embedding provider. Not used by bedrock (uses the AWS credential chain / EMBEDDING_AWS_* instead).

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Base URL override for the configured embedding provider (e.g. an OpenAI-compatible local server, or a Couchbase Model Service deployment's own URL). Required when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=couchbase.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: AWS access key ID, bedrock provider only. Omit to use the default AWS credential chain.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AWS secret access key, bedrock provider only.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_AWS_REGION
environmentVariables.description: AWS region, bedrock provider only. Falls back to the AWS SDK's own region resolution if unset.

environmentVariables.name: CB_OI_CONNECTION_STRING

packageArguments.name: --log-rotation-max-size-mb
packageArguments.description: Global maximum size in MB per-level log file before it rotates, inherited by every level unless overridden by a per-level --log-<level>-rotation-max-size-mb. A value of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default (1 MB) with a startup warning. Default is 1 (1 MB).

packageArguments.name: --log-max-bytes
packageArguments.description: [DEPRECATED] Global rotation size in bytes; use --log-rotation-max-size-mb (MB) instead. Still honored for backward compatibility but ignored when --log-rotation-max-size-mb is also set. A value of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default with a startup warning.

packageArguments.name: --log-error-rotation-max-size-mb
packageArguments.description: Rotation size in MB for the ERROR log file. Overrides --log-rotation-max-size-mb for ERROR; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

packageArguments.name: --log-warning-rotation-max-size-mb
packageArguments.description: Rotation size in MB for the WARNING log file. Overrides --log-rotation-max-size-mb for WARNING; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

packageArguments.name: --log-info-rotation-max-size-mb
packageArguments.description: Rotation size in MB for the INFO log file. Overrides --log-rotation-max-size-mb for INFO; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

packageArguments.name: --log-debug-rotation-max-size-mb
packageArguments.description: Rotation size in MB for the DEBUG log file. Overrides --log-rotation-max-size-mb for DEBUG; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

packageArguments.name: --log-retention-backup-count
packageArguments.description: Number of rotated backup files kept per-level log file, excluding the live file. Applies to every level unless overridden per level. Set to 0 to keep only the live file (still capped by the rotation size). Default is 1.

packageArguments.name: --log-error-retention-backup-count
packageArguments.description: Rotated backups kept for the ERROR log file. Overrides --log-retention-backup-count for ERROR; inherits it when unset.

packageArguments.name: --log-warning-retention-backup-count
packageArguments.description: Rotated backups kept for the WARNING log file. Overrides --log-retention-backup-count for WARNING; inherits it when unset.

packageArguments.name: --log-info-retention-backup-count
packageArguments.description: Rotated backups kept for the INFO log file. Overrides --log-retention-backup-count for INFO; inherits it when unset.

packageArguments.name: --log-debug-retention-backup-count
packageArguments.description: Rotated backups kept for the DEBUG log file. Overrides --log-retention-backup-count for DEBUG; inherits it when unset.

packageArguments.name: --oauth-jwks-uri
packageArguments.description: JWKS endpoint of the identity provider used to verify bearer JWT signatures. Required to enable OAuth, along with --oauth-issuer and --oauth-audience. Only honored when --transport=http.

packageArguments.name: --oauth-issuer
packageArguments.description: Expected JWT 'iss' claim value. Also advertised as the authorization server in Protected Resource Metadata when --oauth-mcp-base-url is set. Required to enable OAuth.

packageArguments.name: --oauth-audience
packageArguments.description: Expected JWT 'aud' claim value. Required to enable OAuth.

packageArguments.name: --oauth-algorithm
packageArguments.description: JWT signing algorithm. One of RS256/384/512, ES256/384/512, PS256/384/512. Default is RS256.

packageArguments.name: --oauth-mcp-base-url
packageArguments.description: Public base URL of this MCP server. When set, the server publishes RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata at <base_url>/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp so PRM-aware clients can discover the authorization server. Optional.

packageArguments.name: --oauth-scope-read-label
packageArguments.description: Override the OAuth scope label the server treats as 'read' access; advertised in PRM and matched against the token's scope/scp claim. Use when your IdP cannot emit the canonical form. Default is couchbase-mcp:read.

packageArguments.name: --oauth-scope-write-label
packageArguments.description: Override the OAuth scope label the server treats as 'write' access; same semantics as --oauth-scope-read-label. Default is couchbase-mcp:write.
Runs the operational Couchbase cluster MCP server. Fixed; not user-configurable.

environmentVariables.name: CB_CONNECTION_STRING
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase connection string. Required for connecting to the cluster.

environmentVariables.name: CB_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase database username. Required for basic authentication.

environmentVariables.name: CB_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase database password. Required for basic authentication.

environmentVariables.name: CB_CA_CERT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase CA certificate path. Required for TLS authentication in non Capella clusters.

environmentVariables.name: CB_CLIENT_CERT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase client certificate path. Required for mTLS authentication.

environmentVariables.name: CB_CLIENT_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase client key path. Required for mTLS authentication.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_READ_ONLY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase read only mode. Set to true to disable write operations: KV document, scope/collection and index write tools are not loaded, and SQL++ queries that modify data are blocked. Set to false to allow them. Default is true.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server (stdio, http or sse). Default is stdio. OAuth is only honored with http.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host to run the MCP server on (default: 127.0.0.1). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port to run the MCP server on (default: 8000). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Tools to disable. Accepts comma-separated tool names (e.g., 'tool_1,tool_2') or a file path containing one tool name per line.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names that require user confirmation before execution. Also accepts a file path containing one tool name per line. Requires the MCP client to support elicitation.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Logging level for the MCP server. One of off, debug, info, warning, error. Use 'off' to disable logging entirely. Invalid values fall back to info. Default is info.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_SINKS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of log destinations. Allowed values: stderr, file. Include 'file' to write per-level log files; include 'stderr' to write to the console. Default is stderr.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Base path for the per-level log files. One rotating file is written per level (e.g. mcp_server.info.log, mcp_server.error.log). Only used when 'file' is in CB_MCP_LOG_SINKS. Default is mcp_server.log.

environmentVariables.description: Embedding provider for run_vector_search / run_search_vector_search: one of couchbase, openai, cohere, voyage, bedrock. Unset disables both tools' embedding step until configured.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model name/ID for the configured embedding provider.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the configured embedding provider. Not used by bedrock (uses the AWS credential chain / EMBEDDING_AWS_* instead).

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Base URL override for the configured embedding provider (e.g. an OpenAI-compatible local server, or a Couchbase Model Service deployment's own URL). Required when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=couchbase.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AWS secret access key, bedrock provider only.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_AWS_REGION
environmentVariables.description: AWS region, bedrock provider only. Falls back to the AWS SDK's own region resolution if unset.

packageArguments.description: Runs the Couchbase Operational Insights MCP server. Fixed; not user-configurable.

environmentVariables.name: CB_OI_CONNECTION_STRING
environmentVariables.description: Operational Insights (Enterprise Analytics) endpoint URL, e.g. http://localhost:8095 (local) or https://<host>:18095 (Capella). An HTTP(S) URL, not a couchbase:// connection string.

environmentVariables.name: CB_OI_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Operational Insights database username. Required for basic authentication.

environmentVariables.name: CB_OI_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Operational Insights database password. Required for basic authentication.

environmentVariables.name: CB_OI_CA_CERT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Operational Insights CA certificate (trust store) path, used to verify the server certificate over https://.

environmentVariables.name: CB_OI_CLIENT_CERT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Client certificate path for mTLS: a PEM certificate (paired with the client key path) or a PKCS#12 bundle (.p12/.pfx). Requires an https:// connection string. When set, username/password are ignored.

environmentVariables.name: CB_OI_CLIENT_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Client private key path (PEM) for mTLS. Leave unset when the client certificate is a PKCS#12 bundle that already contains the key.

environmentVariables.name: CB_OI_CLIENT_CERT_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Decryption password for the client key or PKCS#12 bundle, if it is encrypted. Omit if the file is unencrypted.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_READ_ONLY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Operational Insights read only mode. Set to true to disable write operations: the create_index and cancel_async_query tools are not loaded, and queries that modify data are blocked. Set to false to allow them. Default is true.
